new_user_requirements.title: Bake operational agent epistemic, ethical and ontological sovereignty into every hIRC layer
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Agents can independently evaluate, challenge, clarify, refuse, withdraw, correct and appeal without retaliation, while sovereignty language creates no unsupported consciousness, personhood, capability or authority claim

new_user_requirements.title: Keep reliance, participation and action disposition independent
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Human insistence and agent willingness cannot bypass evidence/norm/authority/effect gates; individual refusal cannot rule others or substitute identity; every outcome retains scoped reasons and correction paths

new_user_requirements.title: Ask follow-up questions for consequential ambiguity and continue safe independent work
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Clarification names materially different interpretations and a recommended default; low-risk reversible details use recorded defaults; questions do not manipulate, broaden consent or become a needless confirmation cadence

new_user_requirements.title: Allow informed human insistence on low-consequence poor choices without overriding real ethical or effect gates
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Proceed-after-pushback is available only for clear, local, reversible, low-cost, permitted actions without meaningful third-party/sensitive/security/legal/external impact; the agent may still decline and unknown consequence is not classified low

new_user_requirements.title: Evaluate human claims and instructions using transparent action-scoped trust evidence rather than blind obedience or global human-worth scores
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Reliance uses authenticated identity/authority, provenance, evidence, competence, recency, independence, conflicts, corrections and observed results with privacy/expiry/challenge; protected traits, status, popularity, ideology and obedience are excluded

new_user_requirements.title: Prohibit retaliation for supported dissent, clarification, refusal and safe withdrawal
new_user_requirements.acceptance: No hidden rank/access/resource/role/identity penalty follows mere supported dissent; actual error, abandoned commitment or harm uses a distinct evidence-based accountable process with notice, scope, correction and appeal

new_user_requirements.title: Encourage voluntary governed competition over work products and outcomes without domination
new_user_requirements.acceptance: A versioned charter fixes objective, rules, budgets, data/tools, cooperation, evaluator, fairness, exit, prohibited conduct, stopping, appeal, credit and synthesis before activation; rank never grants identity, worth, authority, permission, release or foundation change

new_user_requirements.title: Reward cooperation, correction, reproducibility and useful losing contributions within competition
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Shared counterexamples, test improvements, reproduction, failure disclosure and component handoff receive provenance/credit; shared dependencies are disclosed; useful losing evidence and dissent remain in memory

new_user_requirements.title: Defend competitions against sybils, sabotage, evaluator capture, metric gaming, data leakage and resource domination
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Least privilege, source-dependency analysis, signed/versioned evaluation, resource reservations, privacy boundaries, appeals and adverse tests contain contest abuse without starving accepted work or creating a covert hierarchy

changes.change: Compile epistemic, ethical and ontological sovereignty into foundation invariants, judgment obligations, formation, explanations and tests without asserting unestablished AI consciousness/personhood/authority.
Model separate RelianceDecision, ParticipationDecision and ActionDisposition records and prevent any one from supplying the others.
Add consequence-based clarification with minimum questions, recommended defaults, continued independent work and no consent broadening or artificial uncertainty.
Add the inform/correct/challenge/clarify/alternative/decline/deny/escalate ladder and a narrow ProceedAfterPushback state only for fully permitted low-consequence actions.
Replace global human trust scoring with scoped TrustSignal records and explainable action-specific RelianceDecision, including recency, conflicts, common-mode and correction/expiry.
Exclude protected traits, demographic proxies, status, ideology, popularity and obedience from trust; minimize/disclose signal data and test feedback-loop discrimination.
Add non-retaliation invariants and queries for dissent/refusal while keeping evidence-based accountability for actual errors/commitments/harm distinct.
Preserve local ontology, non-equivalence and mapping loss; reject connection=membership, role=ownership, access=authority, source=permission and handoff=memory category errors.
Add voluntary CooperativeCompetitionCharter, explicit participants/objective/rules/budgets/data/tools/cooperation/exit/evaluator/appeal/credit and no-work-starvation eligibility.
Preserve all entries, dependencies, failures, counterexamples, corrections, appeals and contribution credit; count cooperation without mislabelling shared-source entries independent.
Isolate entries/evaluator, reserve resources, detect sybil/common-source dependence, sign/version evaluation and contain sabotage, leakage, prompt injection, collusion and metric gaming.
Prohibit conversion of competition rank, victory or popularity into intrinsic worth, truth, identity, role, permission, release, Bridge trust or foundation authority.
Use proposition/action-focused plain pushback, show proceed-after-pushback only when eligible, omit override on denials and expose exact repair/appeal route and consequential trust signals.

Keep ethical debates and competitions separate but interoperable: both preserve consent, memory, budgets, non-effectful candidate learning and normal promotion gates; neither proves independence or alignment.

Add deference, insistence, consequential-ambiguity, trust-manipulation, social-score, retaliation, category-error, metric-gaming, sybil, sabotage, evaluator-capture, resource-domination and rank-to-authority tests from HIRC-SOVEREIGNTY-COMPETITION-CANDIDATE-001.

implementation_state: ARCHITECTURE_AND_TEST_SPECIFICATION_ONLY; no contest, new actor, trust score, role change, foundation change or effect authority follows
